description: Sonic 1 website hero loop: multi-zone montage, hard cuts, fade at the loop ends.

shots.label: Green Hill Act 2: loop and rings
shots.note: The recorded GHZ2 run (native lag rows not replayed), with Right pressed on the frame he lands so he faces and runs right from the first frame; the loop and rings follow as recorded.

shots.label: Scrap Brain Act 1: Sonic 2 lends its art
shots.note: Cross-game donation from Sonic 2, driven by the recorded complete run (native lag rows not replayed): already running right, he drops into the tube and rolls through the ring tunnels; the shot ends before he meets the wall.

shots.label: Special Stage 1: rotating maze
shots.note: GHZ1 played from its recorded level start; the stage is entered through the giant ring by the movie's own input.

shots.label: Spring Yard Act 1: hurt by a Crabmeat, rewound, then a clean jump
shots.note: Declared 15 starting rings so the hit scatters a visible handful. Holding Right instead of the recorded jump runs him into the Crabmeat; holding the live rewind key reverses the hit, and the retry is the recorded jump, which destroys it and the Buzz Bomber beyond.

shots.label: Star Light Act 1: running against a fan
shots.note: Declared start on the platform right of the always-on fan at x 0x0A08; from a standstill he runs left into its wind until he runs in place, and the shot ends on his last skid frame as the fan pushes him right.

shots.label: Spring Yard Act 3: waiting impatiently on the block lifts
shots.note: Declared start where the complete run stands on the moving blocks; left idle long enough for the foot-tapping wait animation.

shots.label: Scrap Brain Act 2: ten Sonic sidekicks on their own CPU
shots.note: Sonic 1 takes sidekicks only with a donor game; Sonic 2 lends its art. The leader leaves the recorded line at the first wall, and the ten followers scatter and jump to catch up.

shots.label: Green Hill Act 2: Super Sonic, borrowed from Sonic 2
shots.note: Declared setup: six emeralds and 60 rings; a second jump press in the air transforms him, then he runs through the Crabmeat ledge and the enemies beyond. The shot ends before he meets the quarterpipe.
